description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is building a scaled Private Equity channel that makes Ramp the trusted financial-operations partner for PE firms and their portfolio companies. The Manager, Channel Partner Management — Private Equity will lead an established five-person team of Channel Partner Managers and raise the quality, rigor, and efficiency of an existing motion.

The team includes one Upmarket PE CPM, focused on the most strategic and complex sponsor relationships, and four Core / Downmarket PE CPMs, focused on scaled coverage, activation, and portfolio-company pipeline generation. This leader is not being hired to redesign the team or recategorize the program. They will make the current team more effective: clarifying expectations, improving performance, and ensuring each CPM has the tools, coaching, and cross-functional support to execute at a high level.

This is a people-leadership and operating-excellence role—not a player-coach role defined by personally owning every senior relationship or stepping into every deal. The manager will diagnose performance and conversion gaps, coach specific skills, establish a rigorous inspection cadence, and hold a high bar for accountability. They will work closely with Channel, Sales, Marketing, Finance, RevOps, and other partners to improve collateral and partner messaging, refine activation and incentive plans, strengthen account and portfolio planning, and remove friction from the CPM workflow.

The goal is continuous improvement: make the team more poised with partners, more commercially disciplined, more efficient in how it spends time, and more consistent in turning PE relationships into high-quality outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead, coach, and develop a five-person PE CPM team: one Upmarket PE CPM and four Core / Downmarket PE CPMs

- Set clear role charters, coverage models, capacity expectations, and success metrics by segment; ensure the Upmarket motion receives the depth it needs while Core / Downmarket operates with speed and repeatability

- Build the team’s commercial operating rhythm across sourced pipeline, qualified opportunities, closed-won revenue, partner activation, portfolio coverage, conversion, velocity, and partner health

- Coach CPMs from real partner interactions and account plans: identify the specific skill gap, prescribe an intervention, inspect behavior change, and hold a high bar for outcomes

- Partner with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Finance, ChOps, Growth, and leadership to convert PE influence into high-quality pipeline and strategic account outcomes

- Recruit, onboard, performance-manage, and retain a high-performing, collaborative team

- Serve as an executive point of escalation for the team’s most strategic PE relationships, using judgment about when to coach, join, or personally intervene

- Use AI and automation to improve research, portfolio coverage, executive preparation, relationship tracking, and team productivity

- Help shape the evolving PE channel strategy and codify repeatable playbooks for the broader Channel organization

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years of relevant quota carrying experience, ideally with a focus on Private Equity firms and their portfolio companies

- 1+ years of people-management experience, ideally leading a revenue-carrying partnerships, sales, or account-management team

- Demonstrated success building and managing a complex book of investor, sponsor, or enterprise partner relationships with measurable commercial outcomes

- Strong commercial judgment: can distinguish influence from source, quantify partner impact, and prioritize finite team capacity against the highest-value opportunities

- A rigorous, data-driven management style; comfortable using funnel health, conversion, velocity, activity quality, and account/partner signals to coach and allocate resources

- Executive presence with PE partners, operating teams, CFOs, and internal senior stakeholders

- Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, create structure, and drive cross-functional outcomes without relying on formal authority

- High standards for performance management, feedback, and talent development

NICE TO HAVES

- Fintech, payments, expense management, AP, procurement, or CFO-software experience

- Experience designing partner programs, referral mechanics, or account-mapping motions

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

OTHER NOTICES

title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

About the Team

The People & Talent team at Airwallex is dedicated to attracting and developing the brightest and most ambitious minds to drive our company forward. We are a global, vibrant, and dynamic team with a focus on creating a positive and inclusive work environment that fosters growth and innovation. Through innovative programs, strategic People & Talent initiatives, and a deep understanding of our organisation's needs, we cultivate a collaborative and engaging environment that fuels Airwallex's continued growth and success.

What You'll Do

You'll be the first Total Rewards team member based in the Americas, with end-to-end ownership of our Compensation, Benefits and Equity programs across the region, covering the US and Canada, Brazil and Mexico. You’ll lead the regional execution and ongoing management of our rewards programs, while partnering with the global Total Rewards team on the design and evolution of programs globally. Airwallex is actively rebuilding and scaling its rewards programs. You’ll own the Americas compensation cycles, keep pay ranges market-aligned, and be the go-to Total Rewards partner for recruiters, managers and People Partners across the region. You’ll work as part of a small, global team, partnering closely with colleagues in Singapore and China.

This role is based in San Francisco.

Responsibilities:

- Design and execute compensation strategy: salary structure, pay differentials, market positioning, merit and bonus cycles, and offer decisions.

- Own benefits lifecycle: plan design, and partner with local people ops team on annual renewals, broker negotiations, ACA/ERISA compliance.

- Partner with the global rewards team to manage company stock plans: RSU, ISO, ESPP mechanics, vesting, taxation, SEC compliance, grant execution, and plan governance.

- Lead Total Rewards projects: design and execute major initiatives across global/the Americas, scope work, align stakeholders, and communicate decisions.

- Partner with the global team on IPO readiness initiatives.

- Use market data and benchmarking to ground decisions; influence stakeholders when decisions misalign with strategy; translate analysis for leadership and employees.

- Partner cross-functionally with TA, People Partners, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and exec leadership on compensation, org decisions, systems, equity budgets, compliance, and strategy.

Who You Are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications:

- 8+ years of experience in total rewards, compensation, or benefits, including experience supporting populations based in the Americas.

- Experience building or managing a complete rewards program (compensation, benefits, equity, etc)

- Experience managing benefits process end to end; including negotiating with brokers and insurance carriers to evaluate and renew plans.

- Strong compensation data analytics capability: own the regular annual market review cycle and influence on company pay strategy/decisions.

- Proven ability to build your own models and projections.

- Working knowledge of US stock administration and equity compensation, including RSUs, vesting mechanics and how to explain them plainly to a non-specialist.

- Experience at a late-stage private or pre-IPO company or transition to public stages, particularly through changes to an equity program.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Exposure to multi-region rewards work, especially where the global framework is set outside your own time zone.

- Familiarity with compensation and equity tooling such as Carta, BambooHR or Workday, and survey sources such as Radford or Compensia.

- Comfort operating with high standards, fast-pace, high pressure, and evolving priorities, with a bias toward building the thing rather than waiting for the playbook.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Associate Business Development Representative
description:
WHO WE ARE

Most companies are racing to deploy AI, but very few have the foundation to make it work reliably. Atlan is building that missing layer: the context layer for enterprise AI. We connect the business context behind data so humans and agents can operate with far more accuracy and confidence.

With backing from world-class investors including GIC, Insight Partners, Meritech, Peak XV, and Salesforce Ventures, we've earned the trust of most AI-forward enterprises like General Motors, Nasdaq, Workday and Elastic.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

What You'll Do

- Learn to own pipeline creation inside a regional pod in North America, working alongside an AE on a shared target - every lead worked quickly, every account multithreaded, no coverage gap left behind.

- Build outbound skills from the ground up - researching accounts, identifying the right stakeholders, and crafting outreach that earns a reply because it's specific and relevant, not because a sequence fired it.

- Qualify with rigor, learning to confirm pain, need, timeline, and authority before booking, so every meeting the pod runs is worth running.

- Work closely with AEs, marketing, and the events team from day one, giving you exposure across the full go-to-market motion rather than a narrow, siloed seat.

- Build your own AI workflows, agents, or systems using AI tools that make you measurably faster and better over time.

We expect this, but here's what you get in return:

- NA hours: 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST, fixed, ongoing. In return: the earliest seat in a category still being defined, real deals with CIOs and AI builders while the playbook's still being written. Only apply if that trade works for you.

- The motion shifts under you constantly - new tools, new personas, new messaging, some weeks all three. You reset fast, take feedback without flinching, hold your own bar with no one watching. Do it for a year and you'll have judgement most three-year reps don't.

- Grow. From here: ABX, GTM Engineering, player-coach/team lead, Customer Success, or partnerships - this is a first step in a career, not just a first job.

- The deals are widening too. Two years ago these deals were almost entirely with data governance teams; today they pull in CIOs, finance, data-security, and AI builders as stakeholders. You'll read a stakeholder map most BDRs don't see this early.

What Makes You a Match

- You've taken the time to understand what the BDR/SDR role actually involves - the outbound work, the qualification process, the day-to-day rhythm.

- Genuinely AI-native, not just an AI user: you've already built something with AI - An automation, an agent, a workflow, a side project - where AI changed how you did the work, not just sped up a single task like writing an email. Come ready to show us what you've built, not just what tools you use.

- You communicate with precision and confidence, in writing and out loud, and you treat personalization as a non-negotiable, not a nice-to-have.

- You're excited by category creation - by the idea of helping define what "AI Context Platform" means.

WHY ATLAN?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

- Competitive Compensation:  We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

- AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

- Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

- Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

- Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

- Global, Remote-First, High-Trust:  Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking:  “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com http://www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn. https://www.linkedin.com/company/atlan-hq/posts/?feedView=all

Equal Opportunity Employer

Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com http://atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers http://atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.

title: Manager, Customer Support AMER
description:
About the Team

Miro's Customer Support team is on a mission to help our customers quickly solve their problems so they can get back to creating the next big thing. We provide enterprise-grade support with empathy and passion, and we strive to exceed user expectations by always thinking one step ahead.

The AMER Support team is at the heart of that mission. Based primarily out of Austin, Miro's largest US hub, we cover the full Americas region across time zones, working in close partnership with our outsourced Tier 1 team and our global support hubs in EMEA and JPAC. Together, we play as a team to win the world.

Mironeers work in a hybrid model, with 2 days a week in our vibrant Austin hub as our baseline. We'd love the person in this role to be based in Austin and engaged in hub life, while staying flexible for the needs of a global team.

About the Role

As Manager, Customer Support AMER, you'll lead the regional team of Customer Support Representatives (Tier 2) and Technical Support Engineers (Tier 3) based primarily in Austin, and you'll oversee delivery of our Tier 1 outsourced support for AMER time zones. You'll be a core member of the Global Support Leadership team, reporting to the Global Head of Customer Support and working closely with peer managers across EMEA and JPAC, as well as our Support Excellence team (Programs, Enablement, and Operations). This is a role for someone who leads with empathy, runs toward hard problems, and takes pride in building high-performing, engaged teams.

What you’ll do

- Lead and develop a mixed team of Customer Support Representatives (Tier 2) and Technical Support Engineers (Tier 3), spanning customer-facing and technical support expertise, conducting regular 1:1s, coaching conversations, ticket QA (quality) reviews, and providing continuous, actionable feedback

- Drive regional performance, ensuring the team consistently meets or exceeds key targets including CSAT, QA scores, SLA adherence, AHT, and a healthy ticket backlog

- Oversee Tier 1 outsourced delivery for AMER time zones, ensuring quality, alignment, and smooth escalation paths

- Handle escalations with confidence, supporting your team on the toughest cases and serving as a point of escalation for complex or sensitive customer situations

- Partner with Customer Success, Sales, and Professional Services on a small number of strategic accounts, providing support visibility in QBRs, proactive ticket coordination when issues escalate, and an internal voice for the customer when it matters most

- Partner with our newly launched Tier 4 technical escalations and incident response team to define clear escalation paths, handoff protocols, and joint ownership for complex customer situations

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Support Excellence, Product, and Engineering to align on customer needs and drive continuous improvement

- Contribute to the global leadership team, bringing an AMER lens to department-wide initiatives, strategy, and decisions

- Lead or participate in projects that improve support delivery, team processes, or the broader customer experience

- Use data and insights to identify trends, surface issues proactively, and inform team and strategic decisions

- Foster a team culture that is engaged, collaborative, psychologically safe, and motivated to grow

What you’ll need

- 5+ years in customer-facing roles in tech, ideally in SaaS

- 2+ years of people management experience, leading teams of individual contributors (5-15 people)

- Experience managing or working alongside outsourced or BPO support teams is a plus

- Strong analytical mindset - comfortable using data to track performance, spot trends, and drive decisions

- Excellent coaching and feedback skills - you know how to develop people at different stages of their growth

- A servant leadership style - you lead by example and are invested in your team's success as much as your own

- Effective cross-functional collaborator - you build relationships, communicate clearly, and can represent your team's perspective in broader discussions

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, track project progress, and anticipate blockers

- High proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese or Spanish (C1/C2) is a plus

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board. https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVG8Fi8Yc=/?moveToWidget=3458764661021134968&cot=10

title: Workplace Coordinator
description:
About the Team

As a core member of the Workplace department, the Operations function is responsible for delivering amazing services to Mironeers. We are a forward-thinking team that uses innovative technology and a data-driven approach to design and implement the policies and protocols that underpin a safe, secure, and world-class hub experience, directly contributing to our "Integrated Workplace Excellence" framework. The Austin hub is one of Miro's key US sites, and this role is its face.

About the Role

We’re looking for an enthusiastic, people-first Workplace Coordinator to become the face of Miro’s Austin hub. This role is rooted in hospitality, you bring the warmth, presence, and attention to detail that makes an office feel exceptional rather than just functional. Whether you come from corporate hospitality, front-of-house background or office management, what matters most is that you genuinely care about the experience of every person who walks through the door.

Beyond the front-of-house, this is also a role with growth. You'll take on broader responsibility across operations, vendor management, and events, supported by an experienced global team spanning Amsterdam, Berlin, London, Yerevan, and beyond. For the right person, this is a springboard into a well-rounded workplace career.

What You'll Do

- Be the face and first impression of the Austin hub, welcoming employees, visitors, and guests with warmth and professionalism every day.

- Own the front-of-house experience: visitor management, space readiness, hospitality setup, and daily presentation standard.

- Keep the hub running smoothly behind the scenes: supplies, maintenance coordination, and building management liaison.

- Support employee experience touchpoints including new hire onboarding tours, internal events, and workplace communications.

- Serve as the on-site anchor for the North America remote service desk,  triage and resolve Jira tickets, escalating when needed and keeping employees informed.

- Uphold and evolve Miro's office policies, visitor experience standards, and operational guidelines for the Austin hub.

- Coordinate vendors and contractors end-to-end, schedule, follow through, and catch issues before they become visible problems

What You'll Need

- A minimum of 2 years experience in workplace operations, hospitality, office coordination, or a customer-facing role, mindset matters more than years.

- A natural hospitality mindset, you thrive on delivering great service and creating welcoming, people-first experiences, able to make anyone feel at ease, from a new hire on day one to leadership

- Strong organisational skills - you can juggle multiple requests, stay ahead of the day, and follow through without being chased.

- Clear, professional communication, written and verbal, comfortable at all levels of the organisation.

- A proactive, solutions-focused approach. Comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where every day can look different. You anticipate needs before they're voiced and take initiative to keep the environment thriving.

- Full-time, on-site availability in Austin, TX, five days a week, this is a front-of-house role by design

- You enjoy creating great spaces and moments that bring people together.

Competencies

- Experience

- 2-3 years experience in workplace operations, corporate front-of-house, office coordination, hospitality, facilities support.

- Experience in a corporate, tech, or hospitality environment where presentation and service standards are consistently high.

title: Intern - Device Build
description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence — sortie-level awareness that has never existed before. None of it works without the hardware in the aircraft. That's what you'll build.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on hardware internship. You'll build, test, and ship the devices that fly in real aircraft at university flight schools and military squadrons. Every unit you assemble ends up in a cockpit, capturing data a pilot and instructor will sit down and review that same day. Nothing here is a prototype exercise. Navi is already live at leading flight schools.

You'll work directly with our hardware and engineering teams, and you'll see the consequences of your work fast — if a unit fails, you'll hear about it, and you'll be part of fixing it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assemble, wire, and bench-test Navi devices — audio capture, mounting hardware, cable harnesses, enclosures

- Diagnose failures on returned or field-reported units and feed what you learn back into the build

- Help improve the build itself — fixturing, assembly documentation, anything that makes the next hundred units faster and more reliable than the last hundred

- Track inventory, components, and BOMs so we never stall a deployment waiting on a part

- Assist in preparing shipments, and willing to learn and assist in other tasks too

- Work alongside engineers across hardware, firmware, and software to close the loop between what we build and what pilots actually experience

ABOUT YOU

- Currently pursuing a degree in engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience — we care more about what you've built than where you're enrolled

- Comfortable with hand tools, wiring and basic electronics debugging

- Careful and consistent. Hardware that flies has to be built the same way every time, and you take that seriously

- You've built physical things — personal projects, robotics teams, Formula SAE, RC aircraft, drones, a workshop in your garage. Tell us about them

- Willing to do the unglamorous work. Some days are assembly and testing, and those units still have to be perfect

- Curious about why things fail and persistent enough to find out

- Comfortable in ambiguity — processes here are still being written, and you'll help write them

NICE TO HAVE

- You know how to fly. A private pilot certificate, student pilot time, or any flight training is a real bonus. Pilots understand the cockpit environment these devices live in, and we'll lean on you for more than device build — flight testing, data collection, ride-alongs, and translating what actually happens in the aircraft back to the engineering team

- Familiarity with aviation systems, avionics, or general aviation aircraft

- CAD, 3D printing, or fabrication experience

- Basic scripting for test automation or data validation

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Pilots trust their lives to the systems in front of them. The device you build is the first link in that chain — if it doesn't capture clean data, nothing downstream works. Interns here own real units going to real customers, not side projects.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- Hardware that ships — your work flies in aircraft at flight schools, airlines, and the U.S. Air Force

- Direct access to the founding team and every part of the stack, from hardware to AI

- A path to a full-time role for interns who prove they can own the build

HOW WE WORK

- Find a way. We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.

- Creativity over control. First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.

- Update fast. Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.

- Intensity with focus. We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

title: Staff Analyst, Finance Analytics & AI
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are an AI-first analytics team. We don't use AI to augment traditional BI workflows — we've replaced them. The Finance Analytics team builds the intelligence layer that Strategic Finance runs on: AI agents that encode repeatable finance processes, Streamlit apps that surface real-time insight, semantic models that let any analyst query complex data in plain English, and workflow automations that collapse hours of manual work into a single prompt.

Our primary development environment is CoCo (Cortex Code), Snowflake's AI coding assistant, and SnowWork, the AI IDE we ship work in. Every deliverable on this team is built AI-first: you design the workflow, you write the prompt, you validate the output. If you are still building dashboards by hand, refreshing Excel files manually, or treating AI as a spell-checker for your code — this role will ask you to operate differently.

This is a high-breadth seat. One week you're building a new AI agent for quarterly revenue analysis; the next you're designing a sensitivity analysis tool for an earnings war room. You are equally comfortable in an AI-IDE, a Python file, and a stakeholder summary for a senior finance leader.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

AI AGENT AND WORKFLOW DEVELOPMENT (PRIMARY FOCUS)

- Design and build skills and agentic experiences that encode repeatable finance workflows — revenue analysis, cost monitoring, earnings prep, headcount tracking — into reusable, invokable tools using CoCo and CoWork

- Write and iterate on prompt & skill structures (YAML + Markdown skill files) based on output quality and stakeholder feedback

- Build skills  that allows non-technical finance analysts to produce analyst-quality output in a single prompt

- Evaluate model outputs rigorously — you are the quality gate before anything reaches a finance stakeholder

FINANCE ANALYTICS

- Build and maintain quarterly and weekly revenue summary pipelines

- Support sensitivity analysis models for quarterly business reviews & revenue forecast scenarios

- Produce ad-hoc analysis for Strategic Finance

SEMANTIC LAYER & APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT

- Own semantic layers end-to-end — model design, versioning strategy, verified query coverage, and accuracy iteration based on eval metrics; not just build models, but maintain the contract between the model and its consumers across each quarterly iteration

- Develop and deploy production finance dashboards as Streamlit apps (locally and deployed to Snowflake)

- Build customer-facing demo applications for Sales and Field teams

- Apply reusable component patterns and shared utility libraries for consistent, polished UI

EARNINGS AND REPORTING AUTOMATION

- Participate in quarterly earnings cycle prep — scenario tooling, export automation, IR data requests

- Build and maintain source-of-truth reporting exports (multi-tab Excel, formatted to spec)

- Support ad-hoc disclosure and investor relations data needs during quarter-end

HARD SKILLS REQUIRED

MUST-HAVE

AI-assisted development — You have used an LLM coding assistant (CoCo, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development tool. You know how to write a prompt that produces production-ready output, how to steer a model that's heading in the wrong direction, and how to encode domain logic into a reusable, parameterized skill. You have a measurable, trackable record of daily AI usage.

Prompt engineering and skill authoring — You can write a structured prompt (YAML + Markdown or equivalent) that routes correctly 95% of the time, handles edge cases gracefully, and encodes enough domain knowledge that the model behaves like a subject matter expert. You think in terms of context, instructions, examples, and output format — not just "the thing I typed before the code came out."

Python — Modern, type-hinted, readable. You write Python-based applications, data pipelines, and reporting automation. You understand caching, session state, and how to structure a multi-page app cleanly. At the senior level: you've contributed to a shared library or package that others depend on, and you've designed agent orchestration systems — including parallel agent patterns with synthesis layers.

SQL — CTEs, window functions, incremental pipeline patterns. You don't look up the syntax for a row-numbered deduplication.

Data modeling fundamentals — You understand bronze, silver, and gold data models conceptually and contribute to the gold layers and how they translate to semantic layer. You know not just how to build a model, but how to version it, evaluate SQL generation accuracy, maintain a verified query library, and iterate based on real analyst feedback. A non-technical user should be able to query your model in plain English and get a correct answer.

STRONG PLUS

- Snowflake Cortex — Cortex Analyst, Cortex Agents, AI_SUMMARIZE, AI_EXTRACT, Dynamic Tables, semantic views

- SnowWork / CoCo — Prior experience deploying agents, authoring skill files, or working within the Snowflake Intelligence ecosystem

- Finance literacy — You can read a revenue waterfall, distinguish ARR from NRR, and explain what drives a QoQ change in product revenue

- Reporting automation — openpyxl, multi-tab Excel exports formatted to spec, named ranges

- dbt — Model authoring, ref() patterns, YAML tests in a cloud warehouse context

- Semantic search / embeddings — Vector similarity, embedding-based retrieval, and how they power natural language analytics

SOFT SKILLS REQUIRED

TRANSLATES BETWEEN AI, DATA, AND FINANCE

Your stakeholders are financial analysts and senior directors who think in Excel models and board decks. You write prompts and code, but your output needs to make sense to someone who has never opened a terminal. You are the translation layer between what the model can do and what finance actually needs.
You communicate complex ideas simply, ensuring stakeholders understand, trust, and can act on what you build. You are the translation layer between what the model can do and what finance actually needs.

You set the standard for how agents are built on this team. Junior analysts look to your skills and code as the reference implementation. You push back on shortcuts that create maintenance debt. You don't wait to be asked to improve shared infrastructure.

THINKS IN WORKFLOWS, NOT TASKS

You don't just answer a question — you build a tool that answers it forever. When asked to do something twice, you automate it. Your instinct is to encode work into a reusable agent, not to redo it manually each week. At the senior level, this extends to the team: when the team does something repeatedly, you build the shared infrastructure that makes everyone faster.

WORKS FAST WITH HIGH ACCURACY

The role runs on a weekly cadence tied to finance deliverables. You scope, build, and ship a working artifact in 1–2 days. Accuracy matters more than speed — but accuracy is not a reason to be perpetually slow.

COMFORTABLE WITH AMBIGUITY

The brief is often: "Can you build something like the earnings tool, but for sensitivity analysis?" You scope it, build a working prototype, and come back for feedback — not a list of clarifying questions.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

- 3-5+ years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or a technical finance adjacent role

- Has used an AI coding assistant as a primary development tool — daily usage, not occasional

- Proficient in SQL — you can write a window function without looking it up

- Has shipped multiple Python applications that end-users actually interacted with; at least one is actively maintained in production

- Comfortable working in Git (PRs, branches, code review)

- Familiar with fiscal year concepts and core revenue metrics (ARR, bookings, NRR)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS

- You've taken ownership of the quarterly and weekly revenue analysis workflows — they run correctly on schedule without hand-holding

- You've shipped at least one Streamlit app to production or a demo application to the Finance Workloads team

- You've participated in at least one quarterly earnings cycle

- You've contributed a module, skill, or shared component to the team's shared infrastructure — something other analysts use without you having to explain it

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNUSUAL AT THIS LEVEL

This seat asks you to do all of that and build the AI infrastructure that makes the entire Finance Analytics team faster. You are simultaneously a practitioner and a workflow engineer.

If you are fluent with AI development tools, you can punch significantly above your level. At the senior level, you are not just building the infrastructure — you are deciding what it should be. That means making architectural calls that hold across quarters, not just shipping the next feature.

description:

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Staff Network Engineer

Location: MPK/Bellevue/Dublin

Snowflake's Enterprise Technology Network Services team is looking for a Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, operation, and optimization of our Zero Trust and secure-access platform. This role is Zscaler-centric — you will own the health, performance, and roadmap of our ZIA/ZPA deployment — while working across a modern, multi-cloud network stack that supports a global workforce of 10,000+ users. You'll be the escalation point for the most complex connectivity issues and a driver of automation and observability across the environment.

What You'll Do

- Own and operate the Zscaler platform (ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, ZCC) end-to-end, including policy frameworks, app-segmentation models, PAC/traffic-forwarding standards, App Connector topology, and NSS/log-streaming design.

- Troubleshoot secure-access incidents like tunnel flapping, broker/connector health, SSL inspection edge cases, DNS/DTLS failures, and lead root-cause analysis for systemic issues.

- Manage Palo Alto firewalls, Panorama and GlobalProtect VPN, while planning migration toward Zscaler solutions.

- Support Aruba (Central) Wireless, Ekahau and Cisco Catalyst switches globally.

- Design, install, and configure network devices and ISP circuits at new offices.

- Build automation and observability: leverage log analytics (we run our network telemetry through Snowflake) to create dashboards, alerting, and proactive detection.

- Troubleshoot secure Network constructs in AWS, Azure, and GCP such as NVAs, NSG, VPC, UDR, DirectConnect, ExpressRoute.

- Author technical runbooks, escalation procedures, and knowledge-base content.

- Participate in on-call rotations for the changes and lead responses to major network incidents.

- Be able to travel internationally for short periods of time for site builds.

What You'll Bring

- At least 10 years of enterprise network infrastructure experience, including 3+ years of hands-on Zscaler ZIA/ZPA design and deployment at scale.

- Recognized depth in Zero Trust / SASE architecture with expertise in ZTNA, proxy/SWG, SSL inspection, and cloud security.

- Hands-on Palo Alto (PAN-OS, GlobalProtect, Panorama) and enterprise VPN experience.

- Aruba wireless and Cisco LAN/WAN (routing, switching, 802.1x) fundamentals.

- Strong TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, TLS/DTLS, BGP, and QoS troubleshooting skills.

- Multi-cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) networking and site-to-cloud connectivity experience.

- Automation mindset: Python scripting, API config, and log observability (SQL/Snowflake a plus).

- Strong ITSM management, documentation, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

- Certifications: Zscaler (ZCCA-IA/PA, ZDTA), Palo Alto (PCNSE), Aruba (ACMA/ACMP), or Cisco (CCNA/CCNP).

- Experience migrating legacy VPNs (GlobalProtect) to ZPA.

- Familiarity with SASE and network-as-code/IaC (Terraform).

- Experience operating in high-growth SaaS or cloud-native environments.

description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a technically grounded and detail-oriented Product Manager II to own a defined slice of the dealer experience and integrations surface within Tekion's GM Digital Retail Platform (DRP) program. This is a delivery-focused product role — you will translate GM program requirements into well-scoped, shippable capabilities that improve the dealer-facing experience and keep the AEC–GM DRP integration reliable.

You will operate at the intersection of OEM program management, platform engineering, and dealer-facing product design — partnering with GM's business and technical contacts, Tekion's engineering squad, and Dealer Success. Working within the broader GM DRP roadmap set by senior and staff product leaders, you will own your features and integration workstreams end-to-end: spec, prioritise, deliver, and iterate.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support Cx Experience - Support the GM DRP customer (Cx) experience — the consumer-facing digital retail journey across vehicle discovery, deal configuration, F&I presentation, and online-to-in-store handoff. Own the delivery of assigned Cx capabilities within GM DRP, ensuring the consumer flow stays consistent with GM's brand and program standards and connects cleanly to the dealer workflow. Partner with Design and GM's Cx teams to translate customer journey requirements into well-scoped, execution-ready backlog items, and iterate based on customer behaviour and conversion signals.

• Support Integration Delivery - Own the delivery of assigned integrations between Tekion's AEC platform and GM's DRP infrastructure —including inventory syndication, pricing/deal data sync, and status updates — working within the integration architecture and standards defined by senior product and engineering leads.

• Own the Scrum Team Backlog - Write precise user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specs for your engineering squad. Maintain a groomed, well-prioritised backlog that balances GM program milestones, dealer experience improvements, and platform stability.

• Contribute to Data Contracts - Partner with platform and data engineering to define and document API schemas, webhooks, and event-driven data flows for your features; help ensure data integrity across DMS, GM DRP, and third-party systems.

• Partner on GM OEM & Dealer Success Alignment - Serve as a product point of contact for GM's business and technical teams on your workstreams; translate program requirements into well-scoped deliverables and work with Dealer Success to capture and close field feedback loops.

• Track Feature Adoption & Integration Health Metrics - Define and monitor success metrics for your capabilities — dealer adoption, deal completion rates, integration reliability (uptime/latency), and error rates. Iterate on features based on data and dealer feedback.

• Support Integration Troubleshooting - Build the technical depth to help diagnose API failures, data-sync mismatches, and event-pipeline issues on your surface, and partner with engineering to drive fixes to root cause.

• Drive Cross-Functional Coordination - Coordinate across Engineering, GM OEM, Dealer Success, Design, and Platform teams to resolve requirement conflicts, manage dependencies, and keep shared delivery timelines on track; escalate trade-offs clearly.

• Support Change Management & Dealer Adoption - Partner with Dealer Success and enablement teams to build rollout plans, training assets, and adoption materials for new features and integration changes.

• Support Compliance & Certification Readiness - Ensure the features and integrations you own meet GM's compliance, security, and certification requirements, and contribute to quarterly OEM program reviews.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

• 3–5 years of Product Management experience In platform, enterprise SaaS, or OEM/B2B technology products. Experience owning both functional features and integration-oriented capabilities is strongly preferred.

• Working understanding of system integrations Familiar with RESTful APIs, webhooks, and event-driven data flows (Kafka or equivalent). Able to read and review API specs, identify integration gaps, and collaborate directly with engineers on resolution.

• Ability to translate OEM or enterprise requirements into specifications Demonstrated experience decomposing enterprise or OEM business needs into API contracts, data models, and well-scoped engineering deliverables.

• Data-driven mindset - Experience defining KPIs, tracking adoption and reliability metrics, and iterating on product decisions based on quantitative and qualitative signals.

• Strong stakeholder collaboration - Able to align engineering, OEM business contacts, and Dealer Success on scoped deliverables, and communicate trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication - Able to write crisp PRDs, user stories, and integration specs, and communicate status and trade-offs with clarity.

• Structured problem-solving - Ability to navigate ambiguous OEM requirements, decompose complex workflows, and drive decisions in the absence of full information.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in CS, IT, Engineering, Business, or a related field

GOOD TO HAVE

• Experience in automotive retail technology, OEM digital programs, or dealer-facing platforms.

• Familiarity with OEM digital retail programs (GM DRP, Honda ODSX, or equivalent) or certified DMS integrations.

• Background in automotive deal desking, F&I workflows, or vehicle configuration systems.

• Exposure to OEM certification and compliance processes.

• Experience with AI/ML-powered platform capabilities or agentic integrations.

• Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery — backlog management, sprint planning, and story-writing at pace.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN AT TEKION

This role puts you inside one of the largest automotive OEM digital retail programs in the US, with real ownership from day one. As a PM II on GM DRP, you will:

• Own dealer-facing features and integration workstreams that GM dealers use every day.

• Sit at the translation layer between GM program requirements and Tekion engineering — a high-leverage, high-visibility position.

• Build hands-on depth across dealer experience, digital retailing, and AEC–GM DRP integrations.

• Grow your OEM partnership and integration product skills in one of the most active program environments in the company, with a clear path toward senior and staff scope.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Headquarters: Poland - Remote

At INGENIOUS.BUILD, we have developed a top-notch platform for companies in the real estate and construction industries worldwide. Our platform enables companies to easily manage all aspects of their projects from start to finish, both internally and with other project participants.

Joining INGENIOUS.BUILD means embarking on an incredible journey to create the first cloud application for managing the entire lifecycle of a real estate construction project. You'll be building what some consider the holy grail of construction project management. It's a big, bold, and audacious endeavor, and if you have what it takes, you'll play a direct role in its development.

And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll be directly involved in its development. The rest, as they say, will be history...

About the role:

We are actively seeking a skilled Senior Product Designer to join our dynamic team. As a Product Designer at INGENIOUS.BUILD, you’ll play a key role in crafting and enhancing user interfaces for our platform in close collaboration with product management and engineering teams. You’ll have the opportunity to build prototypes, gather feedback from stakeholders, and ensure the seamless integration of design elements across our platform. Your work will directly contribute to delivering exceptional user experiences and the overall success of our product.  If you’re passionate about creating intuitive, user-centered designs and thrive in a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

In this position, you will:

- Collaborate closely with product management and engineering teams to create impactful user interfaces

- Develop clickable prototypes to demonstrate design concepts and gather feedback

- Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and incorporate feedback into design iterations

- Lead rapid design exploration and prototyping to validate concepts early in the product development cycle.

- Plan and execute user research and testing efforts, including A/B tests, usability studies, and experiments.

- Synthesize research, behavioral data, and test outcomes into clear design recommendations.

- Drive continuous design iteration based on user feedback, product metrics, and business impact.

- Conduct competition research to inform design decisions.

- Assist developers during the implementation phase by providing support and clarifications

- Utilize INGENIOUS.BUILD Design System to maintain consistency across the product

- Take ownership of features and drive them from conception to delivery

- Create user-friendly interfaces for the complex B2B web application

Skills and Experience needed:

- Minimum of 5 years experience as a UX/UI/Product Designer or in a similar role

- Demonstrated strong teamwork skills coupled with a problem-solving attitude

- Proven experience in rapid design iteration, prototyping, and concept validation.

- Hands-on experience with user research and testing methods, including A/B testing, usability testing, and experiment analysis.

- Strong ability to synthesize user insights, behavioral data, and business needs into clear design solutions.

- Deep understanding of product design processes, interaction design, and user-centered design best practices.

- Familiarity with WCAG accessibility rules

- Proficiency in Figma

- Ability to create and maintain Design System

- Demonstrated self-motivation, a proactive mindset, and an ownership mentality to drive projects independently and deliver high-quality results

Benefits of Working with Us:

- We provide high-performance company laptops for optimal productivity

- Unlimited PTO lets you take the time you need to recharge

- One-time $500 office budget to set up your workspace

- $50 monthly for educational resources, rolling over until year-end

- Stock options so you can share in the company’s growth

We're fired up to learn more about you to see how you can help us on our mission!

We genuinely look forward to receiving your application after submitting your information a member from the Recruitment Team will reach out accordingly.

title: Graphic Design instructor - Project Based
description:
Headquarters: Egypt

iSchool is an innovative and rapidly growing e-learning company that provides online coding and artificial intelligence education to students aged 6 to 18 years old. As a leading platform in the industry, we are committed to equipping the next generation with the skills they need to thrive in the digital era. We are currently seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our team as a Coding Instructor for a project-based position lasting 3 months.
OverviewWe are seeking a Digital Arts Track Instructor responsible for delivering engaging, hands-on sessions that introduce students to the fundamentals of digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D content creation. The instructor will guide students through practical creative workflows using industry-relevant tools such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity.

The role focuses on helping students understand core visual design principles, animation fundamentals, and digital media production while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and project-based learning.
Key Responsibilities- Deliver structured sessions covering digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D modeling fundamentals.
- Teach students how to use digital creative tools including Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity.
- Guide students through hands-on projects such as designing logos, creating vector illustrations, producing short videos, and building simple 3D models.
- Introduce design principles including shape composition, layout, and visual storytelling.
- Teach students how to break complex drawings into simple geometric shapes and design creative visual assets.
- Explain core 2D animation concepts including animation basics, character joints, and shape-based animation techniques.
- Demonstrate how animation is used in games, cartoons, and digital media.
- Teach the fundamentals of video editing including trimming clips, arranging timelines, adding text overlays, and adjusting basic audio.
- Introduce students to 3D modeling concepts using Blender, including navigating the interface and creating simple low‑poly models.
- Explain the differences between Eevee and Cycles render engines and guide students in exporting visual outputs.
- Guide students in importing assets into Unity and organizing them for basic game development workflows.
- Mentor students during exercises and projects while encouraging creativity and experimentation.
- Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals, including composition, layout, and visual storytelling.
-  Practical experience with digital creative tools, such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity.
-  Knowledge of vector illustration and digital design workflows.
-  Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals, including shape-based animation and character joints.
-  Basic knowledge of video editing, including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments.
-  Familiarity with 3D modeling concepts in Blender, including creating simple low-poly models.
-  Basic understanding of render engines (Eevee and Cycles) and exporting visual outputs.
-  Basic knowledge of game development workflows, including importing and organizing assets in Unity.
-  Ability to explain complex creative concepts in a simple and engaging way.
-  Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities.
-  Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills.
- Compatible Salary.
- Flexible Hours.
- Certificate of Experience
- Team Collaboration & Mentorship

title: Director, Customer Experience
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp wins when our customers win. Ramp’s customer base is scaling rapidly, spanning more businesses, more users, and more use cases across increasingly complex finance operations. At the same time, our expanding product surface area — from cards and expense management to bill payments, procurement, vendor management, accounting automation, and emerging products — is creating more nuanced customer needs and more cross-functional support moments. AI is changing what is possible in parallel: giving CX new ways to route, resolve, and guide customers, while raising the bar for where human judgment, specialization, and consultative support matter most.

We are hiring a Director to lead a critical part of our omni-channel Customer Experience organization: the teams and leaders serving customers across Phone, Email, and Chat. You will lead within a 24/7 customer operation, ensuring the right coverage, leadership, and customer experience across channels. This role is accountable for the performance of its channel portfolio, helping customers get the right answer quickly and delivering consistent results across quality, speed, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

The role combines direct leadership of channel teams with close partnership across CX Operations, CX Specialized teams, CX AI Ops, and Product Operations. You will develop strong managers and frontline teams, create real accountability, and stay close enough to the work to understand where customers and teams are getting stuck. You will translate the department’s direction into clear priorities, stronger operating routines, and measurable improvements across Phone, Email, and Chat.

Because Ramp’s CX team sits within the Product organization, this role has close ties to the technical teams and products our customers use every day. That proximity gives CX a unique opportunity to turn frontline insight into better workflows, stronger product feedback loops, and an AI-powered way of working.

This role is a strong fit for a thoughtful, hands-on leader who learns quickly, raises the bar, and makes clear decisions in a fast-changing environment. You are comfortable owning the day-to-day, rolling up your sleeves to understand the work and the product deeply, developing people, setting high standards, and turning complex problems into clear plans that improve outcomes for customers and teams. You will help define how managers lead, how frontline teams use AI and automation, where human judgment matters most, how channels work together, and how CX scales through Ramp’s next chapter.

If you love building high-performing teams, solving hard operational problems, and helping customers win through rapid product, business, and AI-driven change, this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own day-to-day channel execution — lead Phone, Email, and Chat teams, stay close to the work, and drive frontline performance across customer satisfaction, quality, service levels, resolution quality, and productivity.

- Develop CX leadership — coach Managers, set clear expectations, and build accountability for team performance and customer outcomes.

- Serve as an escalation point — help resolve high-priority customer and internal escalations, bringing sound judgment, urgency, and clear communication to complex issues.

- Improve tools, workflows, and channel execution — use product knowledge, customer feedback, quality findings, and performance data to improve operating routines, resolve cross-channel trade-offs, and partner with CX Operations, CX Specialized teams, AI, Product Operations, Product, Engineering, Risk, and other stakeholders on better workflows and automation opportunities.

- Challenge how we operate — evaluate whether our metrics, workflows, team structures, training, and operating model meet today’s customer and business needs. Bring a founder mindset by questioning assumptions, testing new approaches, and helping the organization evolve.

- Shape the AI-powered future of CX — define how CX should evolve as Ramp grows, including how managers lead, how frontline teams use AI and automation, where specialization improves the customer experience, and where human judgment should be elevated.

- Turn strategy and emerging opportunities into scalable operations — translate department priorities and new business areas into clear channel plans, repeatable processes, strong change management, and high adoption across Phone, Email, and Chat.

WHAT YOU NEED

- Experience as a leader who has managed large, complex operational teams in a fast-paced environment; traditional support experience is valuable but not required.

- Exceptional learning agility and horsepower, with startup or similarly high-ownership operating experience; you learn new domains quickly, move through ambiguity, and build structure without waiting for perfect information.

- A record of improving customer-facing operations through rigorous analysis, strategic problem solving, and strong execution, including finding practical solutions to complex problems others may miss.

- An empathetic, direct leadership style that develops people while holding a high personal and team bar for performance, quality, ownership, and follow-through.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to align teams and cross-functional partners around difficult decisions.

- A builder mentality around technology and operations, with experience using AI, automation, or workflow tooling to transform the customer and team experience and drive changes from idea to adoption.

- Curiosity about the business behind the support motion, with the ability to connect customer needs, product complexity, frontline workflows, and company priorities.

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience leading multiple customer-facing channels, such as Phone, Email, Chat, or other real-time and asynchronous support operations.

- Experience in FinTech, financial services, or another complex, highly regulated environment.

- Experience partnering with operations, product, or tooling teams to improve customer-facing workflows across multiple teams.

- Experience scaling customer operations at a high-growth startup.

COMPENSATION

For candidates located in New York City or San Francisco, the base salary range for this role is $220,000–$290,000. For candidates located in all other locations, the base salary range will be between $190,000-$260,000.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: Head of Strategic Accounts, Enterprise, Americas
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Enterprise Business team at Airwallex is a high-performing, collaborative group focused on transforming how large global businesses operate. We deliver innovative payments and financial technology solutions that simplify complex operations and support growth for enterprise clients. Our team values strategic thinking, customer focus, commercial excellence, and a deep understanding of the challenges faced by multinational organizations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Head of Strategic Accounts will be a founding sales role at Airwallex. As the first person in this role in the Americas, you will focus on selling our API-powered financial technology platform to Fortune 500 companies and organizations of comparable scale.

You will use your existing network, industry expertise, and enterprise sales experience to create immediate impact for the business. You will own high-value, complex sales cycles from account strategy and prospecting through negotiation, close, onboarding, and expansion. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to exceed volume and revenue targets, build a durable strategic-account pipeline, and establish best practices for the broader US sales organization. The role includes meaningful performance-based upside tied to achieving ambitious targets.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Acquire new strategic customers across North America, with a focus on Fortune 100 and Fortune 500 companies, through your existing network and industry relationships

- Own and drive sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from ideation and prospecting through negotiation, closing, onboarding, and expansion

- Identify new companies, use cases, and opportunities through research and close partnership with our strategy and sales enablement teams

- Develop trusted relationships with senior decision-makers across finance, payments, treasury, technology, procurement, and other relevant functions

- Build and manage a strong, reliable pipeline aligned to revenue and volume targets

- Work collaboratively with colleagues across sales, product, engineering, solutions consulting, strategy, finance, legal, and implementation

- Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial contracts in partnership with legal, finance, and strategy through execution

- Ensure an exceptional customer experience and effective onboarding process for new customers

- Provide regular, accurate reporting on pipeline health, forecasts, KPIs, and performance against targets

- Help define the account strategy, sales methodology, and best practices that will form the foundation of the US strategic accounts motion

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. Preferred qualifications are valuable, but not required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 10+ years of experience selling complex technology solutions to enterprise accounts

- An established network of senior decision-makers and influencers responsible for payments, financial operations, treasury, or related functions at Fortune 500 companies or organizations of comparable scale

- Demonstrated experience selling API-driven or technically complex solutions with meaningful integration requirements

- A track record of exceeding revenue and sales targets in sophisticated, consultative enterprise sales environments

- Experience navigating long, complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, business units, and geographies

- Strong analytical skills, business acumen, and disciplined pipeline-management habits

- Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and solution-selling skills

- Experience identifying, influencing, and aligning key decision-makers and stakeholders

- A collaborative and adaptable working style, with the ability to operate effectively across functions, cultures, and levels of seniority

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience working at a fintech, payments, banking, or financial technology company

- Experience selling infrastructure, APIs, embedded finance, or other technology products that require technical integration

- A technical product mindset and a passion for solving complex customer problems through technology

- Experience building a new sales motion, strategic accounts program, or market from the ground up

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

工作职责

线索挖掘与整理（Leads Generation）
利用多种渠道（官网注册、活动名单、线上表单、第三方平台等）挖掘潜在客户线索，并进行结构化整理与分类。
基于业务画像（行业、公司规模、场景需求等）对线索进行初步甄别与优先级排序，为销售团队提供高质量线索池。

AI 驱动的线索识别与评分
熟练使用和不断优化内部及外部的 AI 工具（如：线索评分模型、意向识别模型、自动标签工具等），提升线索识别与筛选效率。
与数据/产品/运营团队合作，基于业务逻辑不断提出对 线索评分模型 与 客户画像标签 的优化建议。
持续追踪各类 AI 工具的使用效果，通过数据分析不断迭代线索获取和筛选策略。

AI 辅助的触达与培育
使用 AI 辅助写作工具 批量生成并个性化优化触达话术（邮件模版、短信/IM 文案、话术脚本等），提升打开率与回复率。
设计并执行基于 AI 的自动化触达与培育流程（例如：不同意向等级客户的分层触达节奏与内容），提高线索激活率。
通过 A/B Test 和数据复盘，持续优化 AI 生成内容的转化表现。

数据分析与流程优化
定期输出线索漏斗数据分析（线索获取 → 触达 → 激活 → 转化），识别关键瓶颈并提出改进方案。
与销售、市场、运营等团队跨部门协作，打通线索流转流程，提升整体线索生命周期管理效率。
关注行业最佳实践与 AI 在市场/销售领域的应用趋势，并转化为可落地的优化动作。

知识沉淀与团队赋能
建立并持续维护线索获取与 AI 工具使用的 SOP / Playbook。
为销售与营销团队提供关于 AI 工具使用、线索跟进策略等方面的培训与支持。

任职要求

教育与经验
本科及以上学历，专业不限，市场营销、经济、统计、数学、计算机等相关专业优先。
1–3 年及以上 销售运营 / 市场运营 / 线索运营 / 数据运营 相关工作经验，有 B2B、SaaS、金融科技行业经验者优先。
有使用 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT、Claude、Midjourney 等）辅助工作经验者优先；有参与过模型应用/智能评分项目者加分。

技能要求
